measurement.dead_tail_definition: successor_or_handoff_boundary_at - last_meaningful_progress_at when both are known

next_corrective_experiment.hypothesis: Short turns are primarily caused by work packets that are too small and voluntary termination after the first bounded unit.
next_corrective_experiment.change: At wake, select multiple useful checkpointable units sufficient for the full quarter-hour; after each unit immediately pull the next until successor handoff or terminal state.
